headline: New agent guide for adopting Future Defaults after optional version update
summary: Adds the future-defaults guide that the upgrade CLI copies and hands to a coding agent. It tells the agent to set experimental.agenticAutoUpgrade, follow each adoption document, verify, then return to shared.md for delivery. It is marked draft, but the text directly steers an agent that edits user repositories.
reason: Instruction text is executed by an agent that modifies user code and config, so wording changes agent behavior even though the file is docs.
risk_signals: agent instructions that drive automated edits to user repositories
tells agent to remove opt-outs and TODO markers and set config
focus: Guide wording matches the prompt in next-upgrade.ts, which says to read this guide after a version update and to adopt the listed documents in order
The skip-if-unsupported rule for experimental.agenticAutoUpgrade is consistent with the other guides
The shared.md delivery handoff matches the commit and PR rules in shared.md
